name: gemini
label: Gemini CLI
install: Install the Gemini CLI (npm i -g @google/gemini-cli) and set GEMINI_API_KEY or sign in
auth: GEMINI_API_KEY (the same key the image step uses) or a Google login.
_toolPolicy: No per-tool allowlist and every call auto-approved (yolo): the prompt's contract is the only rule.
_prompt: -p with an empty value: the prompt on stdin is appended to it.
